in_marathi.name: Ansansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ansa' meaning answer and 'ansh' meaning peace. In Hindu mythology, Ansansh is considered a name of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the divine answer to all existential questions and the peace that comes from knowing the truth.
